sources.snippet: From contractor reports (2022–2024): - **Seal failure timeline:** Premium spacer (Super Spacer) typically holds 20+ years; aluminum spacer fails 12–15 years - **Fogging:** Rare on Marvin premium; more common on builder-grade vinyl windows - **Gas loss:** ~1–2% per year is normal; rapid fogging indicates seal failure - **Cardinal glass quality:** Generally excellent reputation; few warranty claims
